hooks.command: bash -c 'input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".command // empty" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "git\s+(reset\s+--hard|clean\s+-f|push\s+--force|push\s+-f|checkout\s+--\s+\.)" 2>/dev/null; then echo "BLOCK: Destructive git command detected. Confirm with user first." >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$file" | grep -qE "\.(env|env\.local|env\.production)$" 2>/dev/null; then echo "BLOCK: Writing directly to env file. Use .env.example instead." >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$"; then logs=$(grep -c "console\.log" "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); anys=$(grep -cE ": any[^a-zA-Z]|<any>|as any" "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); warns=""; [ "$logs" -gt 0 ] && warns="${warns}[WARN] $logs console.log(s). "; [ "$anys" -gt 0 ] && warns="${warns}[WARN] $anys any type(s) -- use proper types. "; [ -n "$warns" ] && echo "$warns" >&2; fi'

bash -c 'input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$"; then logs=$(grep -c "console\.log" "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); anys=$(grep -cE ": any[^a-zA-Z]|<any>|as any" "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); secrets=$(grep -cE "(sk-|sk_live|PRIVATE_KEY|password\s*=)" "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); warns=""; [ "$logs" -gt 0 ] && warns="${warns}[WARN] $logs console.log(s). "; [ "$anys" -gt 0 ] && warns="${warns}[WARN] $anys any type(s). "; [ "$secrets" -gt 0 ] && warns="${warns}[CRITICAL] Possible secrets/keys detected! "; [ -n "$warns" ] && echo "$warns" >&2; fi'
